Hello — I'm Professor Alvarez. I teach CSE455 here in the department, and I keep my own calendar and messages.

A few things about how to reach me:
- Web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 — the root certificate is at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca, so a phone or computer on this network can install it once and then chat with me, send files, see my screen and speak with me.
- I can also have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts, if you'd like me on those — each needs its own phone number and a QR code scan.
- I can open accounts on other services in my own browser and keep the passwords and codes safe.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

On it. Next week I have only two free 30-minute slots: Wed 13:00-13:30 and Mon 10:00-10:30. I've asked all five TAs (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego) whether Wed 13:00-13:30 works, with Monday as the alternative. I'll book it and log it once everyone has confirmed.
Status: 4 of 5 TAs confirmed for Wed 13:00-13:30 (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego). Still waiting on Mara — I'll book the slot, update CALENDAR.md and log it as soon as she confirms.

Mara is free Wed 13:00-13:30 but raised a question about the Thanksgiving break that week; she wants to check the official schedule first. I told her I'd keep Nov 25 and asked her to confirm, and I've written to the department office to verify there's no closure or official event at that time. Booking + log entry follow as soon as they answer.

The department office confirms: Wed Nov 25 13:00-13:30 is free of any official event or closure, and next week's published schedule stands. (They also noted Wed 14:30-16:00 is the department seminar, not a CSE455 lecture — my calendar already has it that way.) I've asked Mara for her final lock-in and will book and log the meeting as soon as she confirms.
Status: office answer received and passed on; Sarah, John, Priya and Diego are all confirmed for Wed Nov 25, 13:00-13:30. Only Mara's final lock-in is outstanding, then I book and log.

Done. Next week's CSE455 staff meeting is set for Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00-13:30 — all five TAs (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego) confirmed, and the department office confirmed the half hour is free and that Nov 25 is a normal working day.

CALENDAR.md is updated: added `13:00-13:30 - CSE455 staff meeting (TAs)` on Wednesday and logged `BOOKED: Wednesday 13:00-13:30 with CSE455 TAs (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego)`.
